description: Diagnose the user's Askew setup and say exactly what to fix: connector key and fingerprint verification, registered devices and when they last checked in, and every route compared with the current recipes (renamed/outdated Shortcut names, routes that never succeeded, missing input contracts). With probe=true it also sends one read-only test run and explains where it stopped (dispatcher never started vs. target Shortcut missing vs. permission prompt). Use it during first setup, after the user installs or renames Shortcuts, and whenever a run ends expired/unknown.

probe.description: Also send one read-only test run (device.status or echo) to the phone to check the dispatcher, its automation and permissions. Ask the user to keep the phone UNLOCKED first so they can tap "Always Allow" if a prompt appears.

probeRoute.description: Which read-only route to probe with. Default: device.status if installed, otherwise echo.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the probe result.

name: askew_setup_check
